title: 超穎透鏡製程研究~Metalens fabrication research
focus: 從超穎原子相位庫到 EBL／DUV 曝光、高深寬比蝕刻與聚焦效率驗收的平面透鏡製程工程~From meta-atom phase libraries to EBL/DUV exposure, high-aspect-ratio etching and focusing-efficiency acceptance of flat lenses
summary: 以 532 nm、NA 0.8 的 TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎透鏡為主線，從廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣出發，解釋奈米柱如何在 600 nm 高度內覆蓋 2π 相位，再比較電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機的解析度與產能，最後把蝕刻側壁、關鍵尺寸均勻性、色差與拼接誤差整合成可量測的聚焦效率與 Strehl 預算。~Using a 532 nm, NA 0.8 TiO₂ nanopillar metalens as the running case, the course starts from the generalized Snell law and phase sampling, shows how pillars cover 2π of phase within 600 nm of height, compares electron-beam direct write with DUV steppers for resolution and throughput, then folds etch sidewalls, critical-dimension uniformity, chromatic focal shift and field stitching into a measurable focusing-efficiency and Strehl budget.

units.anchor: 雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點~Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice
units.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣~Generalized Snell law and phase sampling
units.mechanism: 超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。要把平面波聚到焦距 f，相位剖面必須是 φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f)，其徑向梯度 dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ 就是廣義 Snell 定律中的面內波向量，透鏡邊緣的 sinθ 即數值孔徑 NA。相位以週期 p 的格點離散取樣，格點既要細到能解析邊緣最陡的相位斜率，又要小於基板內波長以免格點本身繞射。~A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer. To focus a plane wave at distance f the phase must follow φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f), whose radial gradient dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ is the in-plane wavevector of the generalized Snell law, and sinθ at the rim equals the numerical aperture. The phase is sampled on a lattice of pitch p that must resolve the steepest slope at the rim yet stay below the wavelength inside the substrate so that the lattice itself does not diffract.
units.model: 最外圈局部週期 Λ = λ/NA；Nyquist 要求 p ≤ λ/(2·NA)，λ = 532 nm、NA = 0.8 時 p ≤ 332 nm；另需 p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm 避免熔融石英內的格點繞射。取 p = 250 nm，最外圈 Λ = 665 nm 只被 2.66 個超穎原子取樣。~The local period at the rim is Λ = λ/NA; Nyquist requires p ≤ λ/(2·NA), i.e. p ≤ 332 nm for λ = 532 nm and NA = 0.8, and p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm avoids lattice diffraction inside fused silica. With p = 250 nm the outermost period Λ = 665 nm is sampled by only 2.66 meta-atoms.
units.verify: 用設計檔計算每個半徑的相位梯度與每週期取樣數，畫成 r 的函數；再以 FDTD 或 RCWA 對邊緣一個局部光柵週期算繞射效率，與 sinc²(1/N) 的純量估計比較，確認邊緣效率下降量是否在聚焦效率預算內。~From the layout, compute the phase gradient and samples per period as a function of radius; then simulate one local grating period at the rim with FDTD or RCWA and compare its diffraction efficiency with the scalar sinc²(1/N) estimate to confirm that the rim loss fits the focusing-efficiency budget.
units.failure: 為了追求高 NA 而讓邊緣每週期取樣數掉到 2 以下時，外圈能量進入其他繞射級，表現為焦點周圍的環狀背景與聚焦效率隨 NA 急遽下降，而中心區量測仍看似正常。~Pushing NA until the rim falls below two samples per period sends outer-zone energy into other diffraction orders, seen as a ring-shaped background around the focus and a sharp drop in focusing efficiency with NA, while the central zone still measures normally.
units.misconception: 只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。~As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter.

units.anchor: TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫~TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library
units.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋~2π phase coverage of meta-atoms
units.mechanism: 每根 TiO₂ 奈米柱是一段截斷的介電波導，直徑決定基模有效折射率 n_eff，穿透相位約為 (2π/λ)·n_eff·h。直徑從約 80 nm 增到 200 nm 時，532 nm 波長下 n_eff 約從 1.1 升到 2.1，因此固定高度 h 的柱子只靠直徑就能掃過 2π。另一條路是幾何相位：把柱子做成半波片並旋轉角度 θ，對圓偏振光給出 φ = 2θ，覆蓋範圍天生是完整的 2π，但效率由偏振轉換率決定且會把未轉換光留在零階。~Each TiO₂ nanopillar is a truncated dielectric waveguide whose diameter sets the fundamental-mode effective index n_eff, giving a transmission phase of about (2π/λ)·n_eff·h. As the diameter grows from roughly 80 nm to 200 nm at 532 nm, n_eff rises from about 1.1 to 2.1, so pillars of fixed height sweep 2π by diameter alone. The alternative is geometric phase: pillars shaped as half-wave plates and rotated by θ impart φ = 2θ to circularly polarized light, covering a full 2π by construction, but efficiency is set by the polarization-conversion ratio and unconverted light stays in the zeroth order.
units.model: 相位覆蓋 Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ；Δn_eff = 1.0、h = 600 nm、λ = 532 nm 時 Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π，足以涵蓋一整圈並留餘裕；最細柱的深寬比為 600/80 = 7.5。~Phase coverage is Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ; with Δn_eff = 1.0, h = 600 nm and λ = 532 nm, Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π, enough for a full cycle with margin; the thinnest pillar has an aspect ratio of 600/80 = 7.5.
units.verify: 以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫；再製作同直徑的均勻柱陣列，用干涉儀量穿透相位並與模擬曲線比較，偏差應小於 0.2 rad。~Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically; deviations should stay below 0.2 rad.
units.failure: 若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。~A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears.
units.misconception: 奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。~Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit.

units.anchor: 電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機~Electron-beam direct write and DUV stepper
units.title: 曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能~Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput
units.mechanism: 研究階段的超穎透鏡多以 100 keV 電子束直寫定義圖形，光點約 2 nm、特徵尺寸可到 10 nm，寫場約 1 mm，場間拼接與套刻誤差在 20 nm 以內；但寫入時間與曝光面積和劑量成正比、與束流成反比，公分級透鏡需要數百小時。量產改用 248 或 193 nm DUV 步進機，一次曝光一整個 26 × 33 mm 場，解析度由 k₁·λ/NA 決定，大口徑透鏡則由多個場拼接而成。~Research metalenses are usually patterned by 100 keV electron-beam direct write with a spot near 2 nm, features down to 10 nm, write fields of about 1 mm and stitching and overlay errors under 20 nm; but write time scales with exposed area times dose divided by beam current, so a centimetre-class lens would take hundreds of hours. Production moves to 248 or 193 nm DUV steppers that expose a whole 26 × 33 mm field at once with resolution set by k₁·λ/NA, and large apertures are built by stitching several fields.
units.model: EBL 寫入時間 t = A_exp·D/I：直徑 2 mm、填充率 35% 的透鏡 A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm²，劑量 D = 1000 µC/cm²、束流 I = 1 nA 時 t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h；KrF 步進機 λ = 248 nm、NA = 0.8、k₁ = 0.35 的解析度約 110 nm，整場曝光不到 1 s。~EBL write time is t = A_exp·D/I: a 2 mm lens with 35% fill has A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm², and with dose D = 1000 µC/cm² and current I = 1 nA, t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h; a KrF stepper at λ = 248 nm, NA = 0.8 and k₁ = 0.35 resolves about 110 nm and exposes a whole field in under 1 s.
units.verify: 用已知的劑量與束流在測試片上寫一組 1 mm² 圖案，記錄實際寫入時間並與 A·D/I 比較，差額即台架移動與穩定時間；DUV 片則在場邊界量 SEM 影像的柱位移，確認拼接誤差小於 20 nm。~Write a set of 1 mm² test patterns with known dose and current, log the actual time and compare with A·D/I so the difference reveals stage-move and settling overhead; on DUV wafers, measure pillar displacement across field boundaries in SEM images to confirm stitching below 20 nm.
units.failure: EBL 的近接效應使密集區柱子過曝、孤立區欠曝，直徑在同一設計值下相差 10 nm 以上，相位庫映射失效，透鏡出現與圖形密度相關的環狀效率起伏。~EBL proximity effects overexpose dense regions and underexpose isolated ones, so pillars of the same design diameter differ by more than 10 nm; the library mapping breaks and the lens shows ring-shaped efficiency variation tied to pattern density.
units.misconception: 電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。~Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses.

units.anchor: ALD 填充與高深寬比乾蝕刻~ALD fill and high-aspect-ratio dry etch
units.title: 材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制~Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control
units.mechanism: 可見光超穎透鏡需要高折射率、低吸收的材料：TiO₂（n ≈ 2.4、k < 10⁻⁴）與 GaN 適用可見光，非晶矽在 532 nm 吸收過大但在 940 nm 近紅外幾乎無損。TiO₂ 常以原子層沉積填入電子束阻劑的孔洞，再回蝕頂層並去除阻劑，形成垂直側壁的柱子；非晶矽或 GaN 則以硬遮罩加電感耦合電漿乾蝕刻成形。側壁角度、底部殘留與柱頂圓角都會改變 n_eff，等效於直徑誤差。~Visible metalenses need high-index, low-loss materials: TiO₂ (n ≈ 2.4, k < 10⁻⁴) and GaN serve the visible, whereas amorphous silicon absorbs too strongly at 532 nm but is nearly lossless at 940 nm in the near infrared. TiO₂ is usually grown by atomic-layer deposition into holes of an electron-beam resist, then etched back and freed from resist to leave vertical pillars; amorphous silicon or GaN is shaped by inductively coupled plasma etching through a hard mask. Sidewall angle, footing and top rounding all change n_eff and act like diameter errors.
units.model: 側壁偏離垂直 α 時，上下直徑差 Δd = 2·h·tanα；h = 600 nm、α = 2° 時 Δd = 41.9 nm，相當於跨越相位庫中約四個 10 nm 直徑階。ALD 填滿最大 200 nm 孔需 ≥ 100 nm 膜厚，以 0.06 nm/cycle 計約 1,700 個循環。~A sidewall tilted by α from vertical gives a top-to-bottom diameter difference Δd = 2·h·tanα; for h = 600 nm and α = 2°, Δd = 41.9 nm, which spans about four 10 nm diameter steps of the library. Filling the largest 200 nm hole by ALD needs at least 100 nm of film, roughly 1,700 cycles at 0.06 nm per cycle.
units.verify: 切片或傾斜 SEM 量側壁角與柱高，橢偏儀量 ALD 膜的折射率與消光係數，並用一片均勻柱陣列量穿透率；三者代入 RCWA 重新計算相位庫，與原設計曲線比較後決定是否需要重新映射直徑。~Measure sidewall angle and pillar height by cross-section or tilted SEM, measure the ALD film index and extinction by ellipsometry, and measure transmittance on a uniform pillar array; feed all three into RCWA to recompute the library and compare with the design curve before deciding whether diameters must be remapped.
units.failure: 乾蝕刻選擇比不足時硬遮罩在最細柱上先耗盡，柱頂被削成錐形，細柱區（對應相位剖面的特定圈帶）穿透相位系統性偏移，焦點出現可量測的球差。~When etch selectivity is insufficient the hard mask is consumed first on the thinnest pillars, tapering their tops; those pillar bands, which map to specific phase zones, shift phase systematically and the focus shows measurable spherical aberration.
units.misconception: 只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。~If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless.

units.anchor: 焦平面顯微成像與針孔功率計~Focal-plane microscope and pinhole power meter
units.title: 聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測~Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement
units.mechanism: 聚焦效率定義為焦點附近（常取 3 倍 FWHM 半徑的圓）內的功率除以入射功率，必須與穿透率分開報告，因為未聚焦的零階光也會穿透。焦斑用一支 NA 高於待測透鏡的顯微物鏡放大成像到相機，以像素尺寸與放大率換算 FWHM；Strehl 比由實測峰值強度對理想 Airy 峰值的比值求得，或由 PSF 反推波前 RMS。入射光需以已知偏振與準直度照明，否則量到的是光源而非透鏡。~Focusing efficiency is the power inside a circle of about three FWHM radii around the focus divided by the incident power, and must be reported separately from transmittance because undiffracted zeroth-order light is also transmitted. The spot is relayed to a camera by a microscope objective whose NA exceeds that of the lens under test, and FWHM is converted through pixel size and magnification; the Strehl ratio comes from the measured peak against the ideal Airy peak or from the wavefront RMS inferred from the PSF. Illumination must have known polarization and collimation, otherwise the source rather than the lens is being measured.
units.model: 繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm，故針孔或積分圓取直徑約 1 µm；基板背面未鍍膜的 Fresnel 損失 R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5%，須在效率計算中扣除或鍍增透膜消除。~The diffraction-limited FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm, so the pinhole or integration circle is about 1 µm in diameter; the uncoated substrate back face loses R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5% by Fresnel reflection, which must be removed from the efficiency bookkeeping or eliminated with an AR coating.
units.verify: 先用不含超穎結構的同批基板量穿透率做基準，再量透鏡的總穿透與焦點內功率；掃描 z 軸記錄焦斑強度曲線確認真正焦面，並以 NA 0.9 物鏡量 FWHM，與 339 nm 比較；兩種方法的效率差應小於 2%。~Measure transmittance on a bare substrate from the same batch as a baseline, then the total transmission and in-focus power of the lens; scan z to locate the true focal plane from the peak-intensity curve, measure FWHM with an NA 0.9 objective and compare with 339 nm; the two efficiency methods should agree within 2%.
units.failure: 用 NA 0.5 的物鏡觀察 NA 0.8 的焦斑會把 PSF 擴寬一倍以上，FWHM 與 Strehl 都被低估；若同時把零階穿透光算進焦點功率，效率又被高估，兩個錯誤互相掩蓋。~Viewing an NA 0.8 focus with an NA 0.5 objective more than doubles the apparent PSF, underestimating FWHM and Strehl; counting zeroth-order transmission as focal power then overstates efficiency, and the two errors mask each other.
units.misconception: 穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。~A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%.

units.anchor: 波長掃描光源與 z 軸焦點位移~Tunable source and axial focal shift
units.title: 色差、景深與消色差極限~Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits
units.mechanism: 單層超穎透鏡本質上是繞射元件，焦距與波長近似成反比，f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ，與折射透鏡的色差方向相反且大得多。高 NA 時景深 λ/NA² 只有一個微米以下，所以可用頻寬極窄。要消色差必須讓每個超穎原子同時提供正確的相位與群延遲，而群延遲範圍受奈米柱高度限制在數十飛秒，因此消色差設計只在口徑數十微米的透鏡上成立，大口徑則改用多層或繞射折射混合。~A single-layer metalens is intrinsically diffractive: focal length scales roughly inversely with wavelength, f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ, opposite in sign and far larger than refractive chromatic aberration. At high NA the depth of focus λ/NA² is below one micrometre, so the usable bandwidth is very narrow. Achromatization requires each meta-atom to supply the correct phase and group delay together, and the group-delay range available from sub-micrometre pillars is a few tens of femtoseconds, so achromatic designs hold only for apertures of tens of micrometres while larger lenses use multilayer or hybrid refractive-diffractive schemes.
units.model: Δf ≈ −f·Δλ/λ：f = 0.75 mm、Δλ = 8 nm 時 Δf ≈ −11.3 µm，而景深 λ/NA² = 532 nm/0.64 ≈ 0.83 µm，焦點移了約 14 個景深；允許 1 個景深的頻寬僅 Δλ = λ·DOF/f ≈ 0.59 nm。消色差所需群延遲範圍 (√(R² + f²) − f)/c 在 R = 25 µm、f = 50 µm 時為 19.7 fs，在 R = 1 mm、f = 0.75 mm 時達 1.67 ps。~Δf ≈ −f·Δλ/λ: for f = 0.75 mm and Δλ = 8 nm, Δf ≈ −11.3 µm, while the depth of focus λ/NA² = 532 nm/0.64 ≈ 0.83 µm, so the focus moves about 14 depths of focus; the bandwidth for one depth of focus is only Δλ = λ·DOF/f ≈ 0.59 nm. The group-delay range needed for achromatization, (√(R² + f²) − f)/c, is 19.7 fs for R = 25 µm and f = 50 µm but 1.67 ps for R = 1 mm and f = 0.75 mm.
units.verify: 以可調雷射或單色儀每 5 nm 掃一個波長，對每個波長做 z 掃描找焦面並記錄效率，將 f(λ) 與 f₀λ₀/λ 比較；斜率偏離表示超穎原子的相位色散不同於理想繞射，應回饋到庫的群延遲模型。~Scan a tunable laser or monochromator in 5 nm steps, z-scan at each wavelength to locate the focus and log efficiency, and compare f(λ) with f₀λ₀/λ; a slope deviation means the meta-atom phase dispersion differs from the ideal diffractive case and should feed back into the library's group-delay model.
units.failure: 把為 532 nm 雷射設計的透鏡接到 30 nm 頻寬的綠光 LED，焦點沿軸拉成數十微米長的色散光柱，影像對比崩潰，常被誤判為製程缺陷。~Pairing a lens designed for a 532 nm laser with a 30 nm wide green LED stretches the focus into a tens-of-micrometre axial chromatic column; image contrast collapses and the result is often misread as a fabrication defect.
units.misconception: 超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。~A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens.

units.anchor: DUV 場拼接線與背面增透層~DUV field-stitch line and backside AR layer
units.title: 晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位~Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment
units.mechanism: 量產超穎透鏡在 200 或 300 mm 晶圓上一次做出數千顆，整合工作包括背面增透鍍膜、保護層、切割與和影像感測器或 VCSEL 的對位。DUV 步進機的場拼接線會穿過大口徑透鏡，拼接位移等於在該線兩側加一個相位台階，其大小由局部相位梯度決定；模組對位則由透鏡傾斜造成的慧差與去中心造成的影像偏移決定公差。~Production metalenses are made by the thousand on 200 or 300 mm wafers, and integration covers backside antireflection coating, protective layers, dicing and alignment to an image sensor or VCSEL. Stepper field boundaries cross a large-aperture lens, and a stitching displacement equals a phase step across that line whose size is set by the local phase gradient; module alignment tolerances come from the coma induced by lens tilt and the image shift induced by decentre.
units.model: 邊緣相位梯度 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm；20 nm 的拼接位移造成 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 的波前台階，低於 Maréchal 的 λ/14 RMS 許可；若位移達 100 nm，台階為 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6，單獨就吃掉大半預算。~The rim phase gradient is 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm; a 20 nm stitching displacement produces a 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 wavefront step, below the Maréchal λ/14 RMS allowance, whereas a 100 nm displacement gives 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6 and alone consumes most of the budget.
units.verify: 以晶圓級干涉儀或 Shack–Hartmann 量穿透波前，在拼接線位置尋找台階並換算為位移，與 SEM 直接量得的柱位移比對；模組端用 MTF 靶量各視場的 MTF，確認傾斜與去中心在公差內。~Measure the transmitted wavefront with a wafer-level interferometer or Shack–Hartmann sensor, look for a step at the stitch line, convert it to displacement and compare with pillar displacement measured directly by SEM; at module level, measure MTF across the field with a target to confirm tilt and decentre are within tolerance.
units.failure: 切割後的晶粒若以黏著劑固定，固化收縮使透鏡傾斜 0.5°，高 NA 焦點出現不對稱慧差，影像單側模糊；而晶圓級量測因在切割前完成而未能攔截。~A diced die fixed with adhesive can tilt by 0.5° as the adhesive cures, producing asymmetric coma at a high-NA focus and one-sided blur; wafer-level metrology done before dicing cannot intercept it.
units.misconception: 平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。~A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre.

units.anchor: CD 均勻性地圖與驗收數據包~CD-uniformity map and acceptance data package
units.title: 關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接~Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 超穎透鏡的品質最終由每根柱子的直徑誤差決定，因為相位庫把直徑映射成相位，直徑的隨機誤差直接變成波前的隨機誤差。交接文件必須把設計相位圖、量測的 CD 分佈、側壁角、穿透相位驗證、效率對波長曲線、PSF/MTF 與環境測試連成一條可追溯的鏈，讓製程端知道哪個參數的漂移會先讓 Strehl 低於 0.8。~The quality of a metalens is ultimately fixed by the diameter error of every pillar, because the library maps diameter to phase and random diameter error becomes random wavefront error directly. The handoff package must chain the design phase map, measured CD distribution, sidewall angle, transmitted-phase verification, efficiency-versus-wavelength curve, PSF/MTF and environmental tests into one traceable record so the process side knows which parameter drift pushes Strehl below 0.8 first.
units.model: 相位庫以直徑 80→200 nm 覆蓋 2π，平均斜率 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm；關鍵尺寸標準差 3 nm 給出 σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad，Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976；σ_CD = 10 nm 時 σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad，Strehl ≈ 0.76，低於 0.8 的驗收門檻。~The library covers 2π over diameters 80→200 nm, a mean slope of 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm; a 3 nm CD standard deviation gives σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad and Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976, while σ_CD = 10 nm gives σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad and Strehl ≈ 0.76, below 0.8.
units.verify: 在晶圓中心、半徑中點與邊緣各取五個位置做 CD-SEM 統計，算出 σ_CD 並換算 Strehl 預測值，與每顆透鏡實測的 Strehl 做散佈圖；若相關性弱，表示主導誤差來自側壁角或材料折射率而非 CD，應更新預算表。~Take CD-SEM statistics at five sites each at wafer centre, mid-radius and edge, convert σ_CD into a predicted Strehl and plot it against the measured Strehl of each lens; weak correlation means the dominant error is sidewall angle or material index rather than CD, and the budget table must be updated.
units.failure: 交接時只附效率平均值而沒有 CD 地圖與側壁角，下一批製程微調後 Strehl 從 0.95 掉到 0.7，卻無法判斷是曝光劑量、蝕刻還是 ALD 折射率漂移所致。~A handoff that reports only mean efficiency without the CD map and sidewall angle leaves the next batch, after a process tweak, with Strehl falling from 0.95 to 0.7 and no way to tell whether exposure dose, etch or ALD index drifted.
units.misconception: 平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。~Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging.

example: 設計練習：λ = 532 nm、直徑 D = 2 mm、f = 0.75 mm 的 TiO₂ 超穎透鏡，NA = sin(atan(1/0.75)) = 0.8。菲涅耳圈數 N = (√(R² + f²) − f)/λ = (1.25 − 0.75) mm/0.532 µm ≈ 940 圈；最外圈寬 λ/NA = 665 nm，以 250 nm 格點取樣得每圈 2.66 個超穎原子，純量估計邊緣局部效率 sinc²(1/2.66) ≈ 0.61。柱子總數 π(1000 µm)²/(0.25 µm)² ≈ 5.0×10⁷ 根。EBL 以 1000 µC/cm²、1 nA、填充率 35% 寫入需 t = 1.1×10⁻² cm² × 10⁻³ C/cm² / 10⁻⁹ A ≈ 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h。景深 λ/NA² ≈ 0.83 µm，焦點移動一個景深對應 Δλ ≈ 0.59 nm，故只適合窄線寬雷射。CD 標準差 3 nm 經 0.052 rad/nm 換算得 σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad，Strehl ≈ 0.976。數值皆為教學假設。~Design exercise: a TiO₂ metalens with λ = 532 nm, diameter D = 2 mm and f = 0.75 mm has NA = sin(atan(1/0.75)) = 0.8. The number of Fresnel zones is N = (√(R² + f²) − f)/λ = (1.25 − 0.75) mm/0.532 µm ≈ 940; the outermost zone is λ/NA = 665 nm wide, sampled by 2.66 meta-atoms on a 250 nm lattice, giving a scalar local rim efficiency of sinc²(1/2.66) ≈ 0.61. The pillar count is π(1000 µm)²/(0.25 µm)² ≈ 5.0×10⁷. EBL at 1000 µC/cm², 1 nA and 35% fill takes t = 1.1×10⁻² cm² × 10⁻³ C/cm² / 10⁻⁹ A ≈ 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h. The depth of focus λ/NA² ≈ 0.83 µm, so moving the focus by one depth of focus needs only Δλ ≈ 0.59 nm, which restricts use to narrow-linewidth lasers. A 3 nm CD standard deviation through 0.052 rad/nm gives σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad and Strehl ≈ 0.976. All values are teaching assumptions.
history: 2011 年哈佛 Capasso 團隊以電漿子天線陣列提出廣義 Snell 定律，2016 年同團隊以 TiO₂ 奈米柱做出可見光高 NA 超穎透鏡，開啟以半導體製程製作透鏡的研究路線；Metalenz 於 2016 年由該團隊衍生成立，2022 年與 STMicroelectronics 把超穎表面光學元件導入 300 mm 半導體產線的飛時測距模組。2024 年哈佛團隊以 DUV 投影微影與場拼接做出直徑 10 公分、含約 187 億根奈米柱的全玻璃超穎透鏡並拍攝太陽與星雲。本課只重建公開物理與製程邏輯，不含任何專有配方。~In 2011 the Capasso group at Harvard proposed the generalized Snell law with plasmonic antenna arrays, and in 2016 the same group demonstrated a visible high-NA metalens from TiO₂ nanopillars, opening the route of making lenses with semiconductor processes; Metalenz spun out of that group in 2016 and in 2022, with STMicroelectronics, brought metasurface optics into time-of-flight modules on 300 mm semiconductor lines. In 2024 the Harvard team used DUV projection lithography with field stitching to build a 10 cm all-glass metalens of about 18.7 billion nanopillars and imaged the Sun and a nebula. This course reconstructs only public physics and process logic, with no proprietary recipe.
